jsonld_raw.name: (350 G) AQUA BERGAMOTA SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made with vegetable waxes.

Aqua Bergamota | A fresh aroma that transports you to the Mediterranean. An invigorating fragrance introduced by a sparkling infusion of bergamot and pink grapefruit, gently mixed with the creaminess of white peach and a delicate floral bouquet of jasmine and blue freesia, over a woody background, softly shaped by cashmere and white musks.

Scent notes:
Top: bergamot, pink grapefruit.
Heart: white peach, blue freesia.
Base: cedar, musk.
